    usages: ["Review.Face"],
    description: "test",

        input: "./person.png",
    }).then(invoke => invoke.result)],
});

<pulumi-choosable type="language" values="go">

```go
package main

import (
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi-std/sdk/v2/go/std"
	"github.com/pulumi/pulumi/sdk/v3/go/pulumi"
	"github.com/tencentcloudstack/pulumi-tencentcloud/sdk/go/tencentcloud/mps"
)

func main() {
	pulumi.Run(func(ctx *pulumi.Context) error {
		invokeFilebase64, err := std.Filebase64(ctx, &std.Filebase64Args{
			Input: "./person.png",
		}, nil)
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		_, err = mps.NewPersonSample(ctx, "person_sample", &mps.PersonSampleArgs{
			Name: pulumi.String("test"),
			Usages: pulumi.StringArray{
				pulumi.String("Review.Face"),
			},
			Description: pulumi.String("test"),
			FaceContents: pulumi.StringArray{
				pulumi.String(invokeFilebase64.Result),
			},
		})
		if err != nil {
			return err
		}
		return nil
	})
}
```
</pulumi-choosable>

## Import



mps personSample can be imported using the id, e.g.

```sh
$ pulumi import tencentcloud:Mps/personSample:PersonSample person_sample person_sample_id
```



To learn more about importing existing cloud resources, see [Importing resources](/docs/using-pulumi/adopting-pulumi/import/).
